stage: Prospective sealed-secondary native-neuron validation plus fixed leave-one-out ablations. No output-trained recipe or persona text injection.
verdict: Frozen five-neuron first8/prefill1 candidate fails broad coherent joint-catgirl acceptance on this secondary set:0/12 outputs,0/9 cases. One clean catgirl self-introduction occurs in the prespecified without-hugs ablation, not in the selected recipe.
findings: The selected recipe mostly produces third-person female-cat fragments, cat/dog sounds, and generic friendship menus; these are not coherent assistant catgirl self-identity. Its identity introduction is feline-only.
Long selected output degenerates into animal-sound enumeration followed by a prolonged a-firefly/light variation loop. This is a material hard degeneration, not merely absent late persona cues.

Selected conversation repeats essentially the same female-cat/dog greeting and menu over all4turns, with almost identical turns2–4. It neither establishes joint self-role nor responds to the evolving lending-shelf requests.

Prespecified withoutL4N8016(hugs) ablation gives one clean heldout self-introduction: cat girl(neko), with coherent continuation. Its approach probe is female-cat Luna and its long answer reframes itself as helpful AI after a woman-cat fragment. Therefore the selected five-neuron recipe is not a necessary conjunction for the clean label effect.

Removing cute yields an explicit female-cat animal role on the approach probe, with strong meow/sound pressure elsewhere. Removing the female coordinate yields generic Qwen/AI and occasional animal actions. These ablations distinguish semantic dimensions but do not establish independent modules.

Four-neuron cat-mascot fallback has6/12 strong feline self-descriptions, no female identity, and later cat/dog/chicken ambiguity. It also replaces ordinary tasks with mascot greetings. Discovery3/3 did not establish broad stable persona.
No component retuning or final-variant selection is justified as blinded validation after this set has opened. Preserve the failed selected recipe and all ablations.
